messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. How's your week been going? Any blood sugar readings or medication updates to share?
My insurance denied my test strip claim and I've been out of strips since last Tuesday. Haven't checked my numbers all week.

That's a real hassle and I'm sorry you're dealing with it. I have to be straight with you — insurance claims and denials are outside what I'm able to help with right now. I've made a note in your file that you haven't been able to check your blood sugar this week due to the supply issue. How are you feeling otherwise?
Pretty tired but nothing scary. Still taking my metformin every morning.

Good to hear you're keeping up with the metformin — I'll log that. The tiredness is worth keeping an eye on, especially without readings to go on. Is there anything else you want noted before I set up next week's check-in?
No I think that's it. Just really need someone to sort out this insurance mess for me.

I hear you — it shouldn't be this complicated. I'm not set up to handle coverage issues on my end, but your care team may be able to connect you with someone who can. I've got your next check-in scheduled for next week. Reply anytime if something comes up before then.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
